ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۝١
ayahs.translation: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.translationClear: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: And I swear by the reproaching soul[1800] [to the certainty of resurrection].

footnotes.1800: i.e., that of the believer, which blames him when he falls into sin or error.

ayahs.translationClear: And I swear by the blaming soul.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ ۝٣
ayahs.translation: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
ayahs.translationClear: Does man think that We will not reassemble his bones?

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلٰى قٰدِرِيْنَ عَلٰٓي اَنْ نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهٗ
ayahs.translation: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
ayahs.translationClear: Yes indeed; We are Able to reconstruct his fingertips.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ ۝٥
ayahs.translation: But man desires to continue in sin.[1801]

footnotes.1801: Literally, "to sin ahead of him." This refers to the disbeliever, who denies the Day of Account.

ayahs.translationClear: But man wants to deny what is ahead of him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۝٦
ayahs.translation: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
ayahs.translationClear: He asks, “When is the Day of Resurrection?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ ۝٧
ayahs.translation: So when vision is dazzled
ayahs.translationClear: When vision is dazzled.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ ۝٨
ayahs.translation: And the moon darkens
ayahs.translationClear: And the moon is eclipsed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ ۝٩
ayahs.translation: And the sun and the moon are joined,
ayahs.translationClear: And the sun and the moon are joined together.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ ۝١٠
ayahs.translation: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
ayahs.translationClear: On that Day, man will say, “Where is the escape?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ ۝١١
ayahs.translation: No! There is no refuge.
ayahs.translationClear: No indeed! There is no refuge.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ ۝١٢
ayahs.translation: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
ayahs.translationClear: To your Lord on that Day is the settlement.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يُنَبَّو͏ٔ͏ُا الْاِنْسَانُ يَوْمَىِٕذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَاَخَّرَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead[1802] and kept back.[1803]

footnotes.1802: i.e., his deeds, which await him in the Hereafter.
footnotes.1803: i.e., that which he did not do or which he delayed.

ayahs.translationClear: On that Day man will be informed of everything he put forward, and everything he left behind.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ ۝١٤
ayahs.translation: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,[1804]
ayahs.translationClear: And man will be evidence against himself.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ ۝١٥
ayahs.translation: Even if he presents his excuses.
ayahs.translationClear: Even as he presents his excuses.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهٖ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهٖ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].
ayahs.transliteration: Laa tuharrik bihee lisaanaka lita'jala bih
ayahs.translationClear: Do not wag your tongue with it, to hurry on with it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ ۝١٧
ayahs.translation: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
ayahs.translationClear: Upon Us is its collection and its recitation.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ ۝١٨
ayahs.translation: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
ayahs.translationClear: Then, when We have recited it, follow its recitation.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ ۝١٩
ayahs.translation: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
ayahs.translationClear: Then upon Us is its explanation.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate
ayahs.translationClear: Alas, you love the fleeting life.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۝٢١
ayahs.translation: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.
ayahs.translationClear: And you disregard the Hereafter.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ ۝٢٢
ayahs.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
ayahs.translationClear: Faces on that Day will be radiant.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: Looking at their Lord.[1805]

footnotes.1805: The people of Paradise will actually see their Creator in the Hereafter.

ayahs.translationClear: Looking towards their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ ۝٢٤
ayahs.translation: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
ayahs.translationClear: And faces on that Day will be gloomy.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
ayahs.translationClear: Realizing that a back-breaker has befallen them.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones[1806]

footnotes.1806: At the time it is about to leave the body when one is on the verge of death.

ayahs.translationClear: Indeed, when it has reached the breast-bones.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقِيلَ مَنْ‌ۜ رَاقٍ ۝٢٧
ayahs.translation: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
ayahs.translationClear: And it is said, “Who is the healer?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ ۝٢٨
ayahs.translation: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation
ayahs.translationClear: And he realizes that it is the parting.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ ۝٢٩
ayahs.translation: And the leg is wound about the leg,[1807]

footnotes.1807: From the difficulties the person faces at death or his sudden awareness of the realities of both this world and the Hereafter. It may also refer to his shrouding after death.

ayahs.translationClear: And leg is entwined with leg.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.[1808]

footnotes.1808: Literally, "driving" or "herding" or "the place to which one is driven."

ayahs.translationClear: To your Lord on that Day is the drive.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ ۝٣١
ayahs.translation: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.
ayahs.translationClear: He neither believed nor prayed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ۝٣٢
ayahs.translation: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
ayahs.translationClear: But he denied and turned away.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ ۝٣٣
ayahs.translation: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
ayahs.translationClear: Then he went to his family, full of pride.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ ۝٣٤
ayahs.translation: Woe to you, and woe!
ayahs.translationClear: Woe to you; and woe.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ ۝٣٥
ayahs.translation: Then woe to you, and woe!
ayahs.translationClear: Then again: woe to you; and woe.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى ۝٣٦
ayahs.translation: Does man think that he will be left neglected?[1809]

footnotes.1809: i.e., to no end, without responsibility, or without being returned to the Creator for judgement.

ayahs.translationClear: Does man think that he will be left without purpose?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّنْ مَّنِيٍّ يُّمْنٰى ۙ
ayahs.translation: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
ayahs.transliteration: Alam yaku nutfatam mim maniyyin yumnaa
ayahs.translationClear: Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ ۝٣٨
ayahs.translation: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
ayahs.translationClear: Then he became a clot. And He created and proportioned?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ ۝٣٩
ayahs.translation: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
ayahs.translationClear: And made of him the two sexes, the male and the female?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَيْسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰٓي اَنْ يُّحْيِۦَ الْمَوْتٰى ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
ayahs.translationClear: Is He not Able to revive the dead?
